ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.35:0.65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity white patch localized to the distal and outer margin of the left lobe. Multiple small, high-contrast white focal blobs (rosettes) distributed across the predominantly low-intensity black medial and right lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 135 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys along the entire linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer margins transitioning into a highly irregular, non-linear trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of circular, high-contrast white-on-black pixel clusters (barnacle scars) concentrated on the right lobe and the medial section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregularity and jaggedness of the trailing edge suggesting significant structural wear or past trauma; dense rosette scarring across 60% of the visible surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique large white pigmentation zone on the outer edge of the left lobe, contrasting sharply with the primarily dark pigmentation of the fluke's interior.
